verdict.rationale: CAM's private equity page lists venture capital funds among its clients and covers growth transactions. It also names one representative capital raise, Hygenco's USD 105 million round from IFC, Siemens and Fullerton. The homepage says the firm advises VC funds and start-ups. There is no dedicated venture financing practice, though, and no evidence of seed or early-stage priced rounds. Missing for 10: a dedicated venture financing practice page, documented seed/Series A coverage across the stage spectrum, stated venture deal volume, and multiple representative venture rounds.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm's venture financing practice covers priced equity rounds from seed through late stage, with stated deal volume or representative transactions on its own pages
